description_en: Queries the monitoring metrics for a dataset acceleration slot
description_zh: 查询并获取数据集加速槽监控指标信息
kebab_example: aliyun paielasticdatasetaccelerator query-slot-metrics --slot-id slot-abcdefgh120000 --dimensions SlotIDs:_xxx --metric-type NetworkReceiveBytesPerSecond --start-time 2020-11-08T15:00:00Z --end-time 2020-11-08T16:00:00Z --time-step 5m --region cn-hangzhou
name: QuerySlotMetrics

parameters.help_en: ID of the dataset acceleration slot that owns the metrics. To get a slot ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/467905.html
parameters.help_zh: 监控指标所属的数据集加速槽ID。如何获取加速槽ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/467905.html
parameters.name: slot_id

parameters.help_en: Set of labels for the metric
parameters.name: dimensions

parameters.help_en:
Type of metric. Valid values:

NetworkReceiveBytesPerSecond: Bytes received per second over the network.

NetworkTransmitBytesPerSecond: Bytes sent per second over the network.

FrontendThroughputBytes: Frontend service throughput in bytes.

FrontendLatencyMicrosecond: Frontend service latency in microseconds.

FrontendIops: Frontend service read frequency (IOPS)
parameters.help_zh:
监控指标的类型，取值如下：
NetworkReceiveBytesPerSecond：每秒网络请求接收量。
NetworkTransmitBytesPerSecond：每秒网络请求发送量。
FrontendThroughputBytes：前端服务吞吐。
FrontendLatencyMicrosecond：前端服务延迟。
FrontendIops：前端服务读取频率
parameters.name: metric_type

parameters.help_en: Start time. Default is one hour before now
parameters.help_zh: 起始时间，默认是1小时前
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: End time. Default is the current time
parameters.help_zh: 截止时间，默认是当前时间
parameters.name: end_time
